import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.processor import Processor


class DimuonAnalyzer(Processor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor"""
    
    def object_preselection(self, events):
        """Build MuonGood collection: pT > 15 GeV, |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = events.Muon
        mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[mask]
        return events
    
    def object_counting(self, events):
        """Store number of selected muons per event"""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events
